messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO multi-window burn exceeded (service=inference-prod) — 5m burn = 3.4x; paging severity=page. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-burn

alex: saw this hit at 20:31 UTC. Confirming noise vs real customer impact. Starting quick triage.

maria: on it, pulling traces. initial look: error spike from model-worker-03 in us-west that causes higher latencies and requeueing — increases observed failure rate.

sam: copying logs, small sample: `ERROR: kv-cache-evict timeout 120s` repeated ~800 times across hosts.

alex: ok — mitigation plan: 1) pause paging for 5m while we validate (reduce noise), 2) apply conservative threshold adjustments for short window, 3) create temp dashboard slice and a followup ticket.

jordan: +1 to pause paging; but we should keep alerting at lower priority. If we mute completely we lose visibility.

nita: suggest switching the 5m window severity to "ops" and only page on 1h sustained >2x. I'll push the change to alertmanager now.

maria: agreed. also preparing a quick hotfix to restart kv-cache worker on affected nodes; will run canary on two hosts.

alex: do the restart, add `--drain-time=10s` flag. maria, ping here when canary looks good.

maria: canary executed on model-worker-03 and model-worker-07; after restart failed error rate dropped by ~70% in 4m. Looks promising.

incident-bot: ACTION: alertmanager silence created (duration=5m) by nita; note=temporary noise suppression while triage proceeds.

sam: pushed a temporary change to the alert rule to de-escalate 5m burn to severity=ops. New fragment below:
```yaml
- alert: SLOBurn_ShortWindow
  expr: slo_burn_rate{service="inference"}[5m] > 3
  for: 0m
  labels:
    severity: ops
  annotations:
    summary: "Short-window SLO burn (5m) — reduced paging to ops"
```

alex: thanks. nita, can you also add a secondary multi-window check so we still page if 1h burn > 2x? put severity=page for that one.

nita: done. rule added and alerted: `SLOBurn_MidWindow` with expr over 1h > 2 and severity=page.

jordan: good. Can someone spin up a quick dashboard panel for the next 6h window showing per-region burn + sample rate? Helps avoid blind spots.

maria: creating dashboard panel now: dashboard link (internal) — /dashboards/slo-burn/ephemeral-2034. Added per-region heatmap and sample traces.

sam: logging follow-up issue: RED-INC-2034 - "Investigate kv-cache evictions causing transient SLO burn" assigned to infra-team, priority P2.

alex: operational notes for handoff: we reduced noisy pages by changing 5m severity to ops, added 1h page rule, restarted affected workers (canary successful), dashboard created, follow-up ticket created. Leaving paging un-muted; only changed severity on short window.

jordan: I'll take next shift. Leaving the working set with maria/sam for escalation. If 1h rule fires, page me and alex.

ops-bot: Handoff created: oncall_next= j jordan; followup_ticket= RED-INC-2034; dashboard= /dashboards/slo-burn/ephemeral-2034.

alex: thanks team. We'll reconvene in the post-incident review to discuss alert thresholds and whether this should get a permanent rule change (multi-window tuning + budget policy). For now, monitoring for recurrence over next 24h. :thumbsup:

maria: leaving logs and a short writeup in the ticket. Also adding suggested threshold candidates for the postmortem.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: silence expired; current situation nominal. If issues recur, new thread will be opened.
